body:
7 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

Rochdale deputy council leader detained at Islamabad airport (Rochdale). Rochdale deputy council leader Daalat Ali was detained twice within 10 days during a civic delegation visit to Pakistan.

You may be able to claim for Turner Brothers asbestos (Spotland). Former workers, their families and people who lived near the Spotland factory can still claim, and there are routes for people exposed elsewhere too.

Middleton Library to explore ghost stories and the real history behind them (Middleton). Middleton Library is hosting a free evening exploring local ghost stories and the historical records behind them on Thursday 26 November 2026.

Rochdale White Ribbon vigil: where Wednesday's walk starts and how to join (Rochdale). Residents are invited to join a free White Ribbon Day vigil walk and service in Rochdale on Wednesday 25 November 2026, commemorating victims of violence and abuse.

Thinking about fostering? Free advice stall at Rochdale Riverside on Wednesday (Rochdale). People considering becoming foster carers can speak to Rochdale Borough Council's fostering team at a free information stall on Wednesday 25 November 2026.

Breakfast with Santa at Queen's Park Café, Heywood (Heywood). Queen's Park Café in Heywood is hosting Breakfast with Santa on six mornings between Saturday 12 and Wednesday 23 December, each running from 10.30am to 12pm.

Christmas carols with Mustard Seed Church, Heywood (Heywood). Mustard Seed Church in Heywood is holding a Christmas carol morning on Sunday 20 December, starting at 9.30am, at Ian's Gate, to the rear of 193 Manchester Road.

Weather: Light rain 5°C in Rochdale today.
